verses.text: Ayik ayek' winhaj Josué t'a lum Sitim, ix schekanb'at chawanh heb' winh winak winh, yik sb'at yil lum heb' winh t'a elk'altak, ix yalan winh t'a heb' winh icha tik: Ixikek b'at heyil lum lum chi', tzeyilan wal tas yaj chonhab' Jericó, xchi winh t'a heb' winh. Ix b'at heb' winh b'i'an, haxo t'a jun ix ajmul ix skuchan Rahab t'a yol chonhab' chi' ix k'och heb' winh sk'an sposado. Ix kan heb' winh t'a spat ix.
Palta ay heb' ix ilan sk'och heb' winh, yuj chi' ix b'at yalan heb' t'a winh sreyal Jericó chi': --Ay juntzanh heb' winh israel ix jawi ul yil ko chonhab' tik, xchi heb'.

Yuj chi', ix yalb'at winh rey chi' t'a ix Rahab chi' icha tik: --Ak'elta juntzanh heb' winh israel ayek' posado chi' t'ayach, ak'och heb' winh t'a yol ko k'ab' yujto tonhej tzul yilb'at ko chonhab' tik heb' winh, xchib'at winh rey chi'.

Ix yalan ix icha tik: --Yeltoni, ay juntzanh heb' winh ix ek' t'a tik, palta manh wojtakok b'ajtil ix kot heb' winh. Haxo yik wanxo sk'ik'b'i ix b'at heb' winh, yujto yora'ilxo smakchaj spuerta'il chonhab'. Manh wojtakok tas b'e'al b'aj ix b'at heb' winh. Tato elanhchamel tzex b'at t'a spatik heb' winh, tekan tzato yamchaj heb' winh heyu'uj, xchi ix. Icha chi' ix aj yalan ix, palta toxo ix sk'ub'ejel heb' winh ix t'a spanhanil yib'anh spat, t'a yalanh juntzanh anh lino manoja'il yaji.

Ixlajwi chi' ix b'at tzak'an heb' winh schekab' winh rey chi' t'a spatik heb' winh yalani, masanto ix k'och heb' winh t'a sti' ha' Jordán b'aj jay ha', ixnhej wal elkan heb' winh soldado chi', ix makchaj spuerta'il chonhab'.
Haxo yik manto waylaj heb' winh chawanh chi', ix k'ek'och ix Rahab t'a yib'anh spat chi' t'a heb' winh, ix yalan ix icha tik:
--Wojtak to ha Jehová ix ak'an jun lum tik t'ayex, yuj chi' ix jawi jun niwan xiwk'olal t'a kib'anh, manhxo honh anima'ok skab'i ayik skab'an he pekal.

Kab'nak spekal ayik heyelnakkot t'a Egipto to ha Jehová pojannak snanhal ha' Chakchak Mar, heyek'nakkot t'a stak'inhal. Kab'annakpax spekal to he satnakkanel chawanh heb' winh sreyal amorreo t'a sk'axepalek' ha' Jordán, haton winhaj Sehón yet' winhaj Og.
Te xiwnak honh ayik kab'annak spekal jun chi'. Malaj mach syal stzak'wan t'ayex, yujto ha Jehová he Diosal, anhejton Dios t'a satcha'anh yet' t'a sat lum lum tik.

Yuj chi' tzin tewi t'ayex to tze lok sb'i Jehová he Diosal yik tzeyak'ankan he ti' t'ayin to tze nakot masanil heb' ayto wu'uj hin b'a yet'ok, icha wal tzex wutej tik. Yuj chi' ak'ek junok seña, tato yel tzeyala'
to tzeyak' niwank'olal t'a yib'anh hin mam hin nun yet' masanil heb' hin nulej yet' masanil tas ay t'a heb', mokab' satelok, xchi ix.

Ix tak'wi heb' winh chawanh chi' icha tik: --Skak' ko ti' to ol hex ko nakoti, anhej tato malaj b'aj tzal jun tik. Ayik ol yak'anoch jun lum tik Jehová t'a yol ko k'ab', ol hach ko kolkaneli, xchi heb' winh t'a ix.

Ha ix Rahab chi', ha t'a yib'anh smuro'al jun chonhab' chi', hata' b'ob'ilk'e spat ix, yuj chi' haxo t'a swentena'il spat ix chi', hata' ix yak'el heb' winh ix. k'ojank'olal ix em t'unhunhok heb' winh t'a spatikel jun chonhab' chi' yuj ix t'a jun ch'anh lasu.

Ayik mantzak em heb' winh, ix yalan ix t'a heb' winh icha tik: --Ixikek t'a kaltak te' t'a lum jolom witz chi', yik manh ol hex ilchaj yuj heb' winh tzex sayanek' chi', tze k'ub'ejel he b'a ta' oxe'ok k'uhal, masanto sjaxkan heb' winh t'a yol chonhab' tik, ichato chi' tzex pax b'aj hex kot chi', xchi ix t'a heb' winh.
Ix yalan heb' winh t'a ix icha tik: --Ol kak'elk'och ko ti' ix kak'kan tik t'ayach,

palta ayik ol honh jawok kak' owal yet' ha chonhab' tik, yowalil lokanokab'em jun chakchak lasu t'a wentena b'aj ol honh ak'em t'unhunhok tik. Tza molb'ankot ha mam ha nun, heb' ha nulej yet' heb' ayto uj ha b'a yet'ok t'a yol ha pat tik.

Tato ay junok tz'el t'a yol ha pat tik ayik wan kak'an owal chi', tato schami, max kanlaj schamel chi' t'a kib'anh, palta tato ha t'a yol ha pat tik ayek' junok scham ku'uj, ha schamel chi' skan t'a kib'anh.
Hanhejtona' tato tzalelta tas tzul ko k'ulej tik, ha honhxo tik manhxo ol kak'elk'och ko ti' ix kak' tik t'ayach, xchi heb' winh.
--Ichokab' ta', xchi ix. Ixlajwi yalan kil ko b'a heb' winh t'a ix, ix stzek'ankanoch jun ch'anh lasu chi' ix t'a swentena'il spat chi'.

Ix k'ekan heb' winh chawanh chi' sk'ub'ejel sb'a oxe' k'uhal t'a kaltak te' t'a jolom witz chi'. Ix ek' heb' winh soldado chi' say heb' winh, palta maj ilchajlaj heb' winh, yuj chi' ix meltzaj heb' winh soldado chi' t'a Jericó chi'.

Haxo heb' winh chawanh ilum lu'um chi', ix emixta heb' winh, ix k'axpajxi'ek' heb' winh t'a ha' Jordán chi', ix k'ochxi heb' winh b'aj aykan winhaj Josué chi', ix och ijan heb' winh yalan t'a winh tastak ix b'at yil heb' winh ta'.
Ix yalan heb' winh icha tik: Ha Jehová wan yak'anoch juntzanh chonhab' chi' t'a yol ko k'ab', yujto ha heb' anima ta' ichato chamnakxo heb' yuj xiwelal t'ayonh, xchi heb' winh.
